conclusion_of_reduced_check: No eight pairwise-disjoint left cosets in either group can have all pairwise subgroup-index gcds at most seven, using the explicitly stated elementary reduction lemmas and the complete computed subgroup lattice.
exact_reduction_obligations: The cyclic-extension/conjugacy enumeration is exhaustive by induction on a generating list. A disjoint family has no coprime-index pair. Arithmetic enumeration gives exactly six index-seven cosets in every feasible eight-index pattern. Every such six-family is checked, and its complement is a coset of an index-seven subgroup L. Each remaining coset translates inside L, where its index is its original index divided by seven. All coprime-index subgroup pairs in representative L classes have product L, verified exactly when such pairs exist, so their cosets cannot be disjoint. Conjugacy transports these checks to every L. This is NOT a direct scan of all eight-coset subsets.
